title: Passado, presente e futuro do jeito fácil
theme: Falar do que aconteceu, do que está acontecendo e do que vai acontecer na viagem, sem travar
goal: Aluno sai sabendo usar "I was", "Did you...?", "I'm + -ing" e "I'm gonna / I'll" em frases prontas de viagem, escolhendo uma forma de futuro e usando sempre.
connects_to: M02 (Visto, imigração e dinheiro) e M04 (Gírias).
module_chunks: I was looking for the subway.
You saw my passport? (o nativo às vezes corta o "did")
I'm gonna look for the subway.

units.title: I was hungry, I was out of cash
units.grammar_focus: Passado com "I was" + estado (hungry, tired, out of cash, lost)
units.real_life_context: Você conta para alguém como foi o dia ruim de ontem na viagem.

grammar.explanation: "Was" é o passado de "am/is". Com "I", o passado é sempre "I was". Dica do Igor: "I was" resolve metade do passado que você precisa na viagem.

grammar.sentence: I was out of _____, so I used my card.
grammar.explanation: "Out of cash" é "sem dinheiro vivo". "Out of" quer dizer "sem": "out of time", "out of gas".

grammar.sentence: I _____ looking for the subway for an hour.
grammar.explanation: "I was looking for..." = eu estava procurando. É o passado de "I'm looking for".
Com país e cidade, use "in": "I was born in Brazil", "I was born in São Paulo".
"Last night" (ontem à noite) pede passado: "I was really tired".

grammar.sentence: I was _____ hungry, I ate two burgers.
grammar.explanation: "So hungry" = com tanta fome. "So", "very" e "really" reforçam o adjetivo.

grammar.sentence: Sorry, I was _____. I didn't know the way.
grammar.explanation: "Lost" é perdido. "I was lost" = eu estava perdido. No presente: "I'm lost".

grammar.hint: Com "I", o passado de "be" é outro
grammar.explanation: "Were" é com "you", "we" e "they". Com "I" (e he/she/it), é "was".
Em inglês, "nascer" é "to be born": "I was born". Sem o "was" a frase fica incompleta.

grammar.passage: Igor: Man, yesterday was crazy. I was lost in Brooklyn, I was out of cash and I was super hungry!
grammar.question: Como o Igor estava de dinheiro ontem? (responda em inglês)
grammar.explanation: Ele disse "I was out of cash": sem dinheiro vivo. Repare como "I was" aparece três vezes seguidas.

listening_speaking.text: Yesterday I was really hungry and tired.
I was out of cash at the store.
I was looking for the subway for hours.
I was born in Brazil, in São Paulo.
Sorry I'm late, I was lost downtown.

roleplay.scenario: Você chega atrasado no encontro com o Igorfina num café de Nova York. Ele quer saber o que aconteceu.
roleplay.opening_line: There you are! Two hours late, my friend. What happened?

objectives.hidden_prompt: user says they were lost (past), e.g. 'I was lost', 'sorry, I was lost', 'I got lost' — must be in English
examples_fail: I am lost (present, not what happened)

objectives.hidden_prompt: user describes a past state with was: 'I was hungry', 'I was tired', 'I was out of cash' — must be in English

roleplay.closing_cue: Igorfina fecha com "Ha! Classic tourist day. Sit down, coffee's on me!" quando obj_2 bater.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 4 turnos):

1. **Student**: ~"Sorry, I was lost."
2. **Igorfina**: "Lost? In New York? And how are you now?"
3. **Student**: ~"I was so hungry!"
4. **Igorfina**: "Ha! Classic tourist day. Sit down, coffee's on me!"
evaluation_focus: Contar o passado com frases curtas

guided_chat.scenario: À noite, o Igorfina manda mensagem perguntando como foi o seu primeiro dia sozinho na cidade.
guided_chat.intro_pt: O Igorfina quer saber como foi o seu dia. Conte usando I was.
guided_chat.opening_message: Yo! First day alone in the city. How was it?

objectives.hidden_prompt: user says how the day was: 'it was good', 'it was crazy', 'it was great', 'it was hard' — must be in English
user tells a past problem with was: 'I was lost', 'I was out of cash', 'I was hungry all day' — must be in English
examples_pass: I was lost in the subway.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user thanks: 'thanks', 'thank you', 'thanks for the tip' — must be in English

guided_chat.closing_cue: Igorfina encerra com "Anytime! Tomorrow is gonna be better!" quando obj_3 bater.
guided_chat.suggested_script:
**Script** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Igorfina**: "Yo! First day alone in the city. How was it?"
2. **Student**: "It was crazy!"
3. **Igorfina**: "Crazy good or crazy bad?"
4. **Student**: "I was out of cash."
5. **Igorfina**: "Tip: there's an ATM next to every subway station."
6. **Student**: "Thanks for the tip!"
7. **Igorfina**: "Anytime! Tomorrow is gonna be better!"

units.title: Did you see my passport?
units.grammar_focus: Perguntas no passado: Did + pessoa + verbo básico
units.real_life_context: Você perdeu algo no hotel e pergunta para as pessoas se viram.

grammar.explanation: Pergunta no passado começa com "Did": "Did you see...?" = você viu...? Dica do Igor: com "did" na frente, o verbo volta para a forma básica.
Depois de "did", o verbo fica na forma básica: "take", não "took". O "did" já carrega o passado.
"Miss the bus" é perder o ônibus. Com "did": "Did we miss the bus?".
"Order" é pedir (no restaurante). "Did they order the coffee?" = eles pediram o café?

grammar.sentence: _____ you see my phone? It was here.
grammar.explanation: "Did you see my phone?" é a pergunta para quando você perdeu algo.

grammar.sentence: A: Did you take the train? B: Yes, I _____.
grammar.explanation: Resposta curta: "Yes, I did" ou "No, I didn't". Não precisa repetir a frase toda.
"I didn't see it" = eu não vi. "Didn't" é a forma curta de "did not".

grammar.hint: Depois de "did", o verbo volta para a forma básica
grammar.explanation: O passado já está no "did". Por isso é "see", não "saw".
A ordem é "Did + you + verbo". Dica do Igor: o nativo às vezes fala "You took the train?" no tom de pergunta, mas o certo para você é começar com "Did".

grammar.passage: Igor: Did you see my passport? Receptionist: No, I didn't. Did you check your bag? Igor: Oh! Here it is!
grammar.question: A recepcionista viu o passaporte? Escreva a resposta dela (em inglês).
grammar.explanation: Ela respondeu "No, I didn't": não vi. E o passaporte estava na mala do Igor o tempo todo.

listening_speaking.text: Excuse me, did you see my passport?
Did you take the train or the bus?
Did we miss the last bus tonight?
No, I didn't see it. Sorry, my friend.
Did they order the coffee for us?

roleplay.scenario: Você perdeu o passaporte no hotel. O Igorfina faz o papel do recepcionista. Pergunte se ele viu e onde procurar.
roleplay.opening_line: Good morning! You look worried. Everything OK?

objectives.label_pt: Perguntar se ele viu o passaporte
objectives.label_en: Ask if he saw your passport
objectives.hidden_prompt: user asks with did whether he saw the passport: 'did you see my passport?', 'did you find a passport?' — must be in English
examples_pass: Excuse me, did you see a passport?

objectives.hidden_prompt: user thanks: 'thank you', 'thanks', 'thank you so much' — must be in English

roleplay.closing_cue: Igorfina fecha com "You're welcome! Keep it in the safe, my friend!" quando obj_2 bater.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 4 turnos):

1. **Student**: ~"Did you see my passport?"
2. **Igorfina**: "Yes! Someone found it at breakfast. Here it is."
3. **Student**: ~"Thank you so much!"
4. **Igorfina**: "You're welcome! Keep it in the safe, my friend!"

guided_chat.scenario: O Igorfina voltou de um passeio com amigos e você quer saber como foi, pelo chat.
guided_chat.intro_pt: O Igorfina foi ao Central Park ontem. Faça perguntas com Did you...?
guided_chat.opening_message: Back from Central Park! Ask me anything, ha!

objectives.hidden_prompt: user asks with did about transport: 'did you take the subway?', 'did you take the bus?', 'did you walk?' — must be in English
user asks with did about eating: 'did you eat?', 'did you eat a hot dog?', 'did you have lunch?' — must be in English
objectives.hint_pt: Did you eat a hot dog?
objectives.hint_en: Did you eat a hot dog?
examples_pass: Did you eat a hot dog?

objectives.hidden_prompt: user reacts positively: 'nice!', 'cool!', 'awesome!', 'sounds fun!' — must be in English

guided_chat.closing_cue: Igorfina encerra com "It was! Next time you're coming with me!" quando obj_3 bater.
guided_chat.suggested_script:
**Script** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Igorfina**: "Back from Central Park! Ask me anything, ha!"
2. **Student**: "Did you take the subway?"
3. **Igorfina**: "Yes, the C train. Super fast."
4. **Student**: "Did you eat a hot dog?"
5. **Igorfina**: "Two! With onions. No regrets."
6. **Student**: "Nice! Sounds fun!"
7. **Igorfina**: "It was! Next time you're coming with me!"

units.title: I'm looking for the subway
units.grammar_focus: Presente: I'm + estado / I'm + verbo com -ing (agora)
units.real_life_context: Você está na rua agora, procurando o metrô, com fome e sem dinheiro vivo.

grammar.sentence: Excuse me, I'm _____ for the subway.
grammar.explanation: "I'm looking for..." = estou procurando. Para o que está acontecendo agora, use "I'm" + verbo com "-ing".

grammar.sentence: I'm _____. Is there a restaurant here?
grammar.explanation: "I'm hungry" = estou com fome. Em inglês, fome é um estado: "I am hungry", não "I have hunger".

grammar.sentence: I'm _____ for the bus to the airport.
grammar.explanation: "I'm waiting for the bus" = estou esperando o ônibus. "Wait for" é o bloco: esperar alguma coisa.

grammar.sentence: Sorry, I'm out of _____. Can I pay by card?
grammar.explanation: Igual ao passado, só que agora: "I'm out of cash" = estou sem dinheiro vivo.
"I'm going to the hotel" = estou indo para o hotel. "Go" vira "going".

grammar.sentence: A: Where are you? B: I'm _____ the station.
grammar.explanation: "At the station" = na estação. "At" é para um ponto, um lugar específico.

grammar.sentence: _____ you take the train every day?
grammar.explanation: Para rotina (o que você faz sempre), a pergunta é com "Do": "Do you take the train every day?".
O "-ing" precisa do "am": "I'm looking". Sem ele a frase fica quebrada.

grammar.hint: Fome é estado: use o verbo "to be"
grammar.explanation: Em português "tenho fome"; em inglês "I'm hungry". Mesmo caso com "thirsty" (sede) e "cold" (frio).

grammar.passage: Igor: Hi! I'm looking for the subway. I'm late and I'm hungry! Woman: The subway is right there, next to the pizza place.
grammar.question: O que fica do lado do metrô? (responda em inglês)
grammar.explanation: Ela disse "next to the pizza place": ao lado da pizzaria. Ótima notícia para quem está "hungry".

listening_speaking.text: Excuse me, I'm looking for the subway.
I'm waiting for the bus to the airport.
I'm really hungry. Is there a restaurant here?
Sorry, I'm out of cash right now.
I'm going to the hotel, see you later!

roleplay.scenario: Você liga para o Igorfina porque está perdido na rua. Ele quer saber onde você está e o que está fazendo.
roleplay.opening_line: Hey! Where are you? The show starts soon!

objectives.hidden_prompt: user says what they are looking for now with I'm + looking for, e.g. 'I'm looking for the subway', 'I'm looking for the theater' — must be in English
examples_pass: I am looking for the station.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user states a present state: 'I'm lost', 'I'm hungry', 'I'm late', 'I'm tired' — must be in English

roleplay.closing_cue: Igorfina fecha com "Relax! Take the A train, I'm waiting at the door!" quando obj_2 bater.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 4 turnos):

1. **Student**: ~"I'm looking for the subway."
2. **Igorfina**: "OK! And how are you doing?"
3. **Student**: ~"I'm lost and I'm late!"
4. **Igorfina**: "Relax! Take the A train, I'm waiting at the door!"
evaluation_focus: "I'm + -ing" para o que está acontecendo agora

guided_chat.scenario: O Igorfina manda mensagem perguntando o que você está fazendo agora, porque quer te encontrar.
guided_chat.intro_pt: O Igorfina quer te encontrar. Conte o que você está fazendo agora.
guided_chat.opening_message: What are you doing right now? Let's meet!

objectives.hidden_prompt: user says what they are doing now with I'm + -ing: 'I'm eating', 'I'm waiting for the bus', 'I'm walking in Times Square' — must be in English
user says where they are now: 'I'm at the station', 'I'm in Times Square', 'I'm at the hotel' — must be in English
user agrees to meet: 'OK, see you there!', 'sure!', 'sounds good!', 'let's go!' — must be in English

guided_chat.closing_cue: Igorfina encerra com "Perfect! I'm on my way!" quando obj_3 bater.
guided_chat.suggested_script:
**Script** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Igorfina**: "What are you doing right now? Let's meet!"
2. **Student**: "I'm waiting for the bus."
3. **Igorfina**: "Nice. Where are you?"
4. **Student**: "I'm at the station."
5. **Igorfina**: "Cool, I'm close! Coffee in ten minutes?"
6. **Student**: "Sounds good! See you there!"
7. **Igorfina**: "Perfect! I'm on my way!"

units.title: I'm gonna... / I'll...
units.grammar_focus: Futuro simples: I'm gonna + verbo / I'll + verbo / Will you...?
units.real_life_context: Você planeja o dia de amanhã na viagem e combina com alguém.

grammar.explanation: "I'm gonna" é o jeito falado de "I'm going to": vou. "Tomorrow I'm gonna take the ferry" = amanhã vou pegar a balsa. Dica do Igor: escolha "gonna" ou "will" e use sempre.

grammar.sentence: I _____ take the bus, it's cheaper.
grammar.explanation: "I'll" é a forma curta de "I will". "I'll take the bus" = vou pegar o ônibus (decidi agora).
Pergunta no futuro com "Will": "Will you take the train?" = você vai pegar o trem?
Depois de "gonna" (e de "will"), o verbo fica na forma básica: "gonna look", "will look".

grammar.sentence: Don't worry, I _____ be there at nine.
grammar.explanation: "I will be there" (ou "I'll be there") = vou estar aí. Frase pronta para combinar horário.

grammar.sentence: Next week I'm _____ to visit Miami.
grammar.explanation: "I'm gonna visit Miami" ou "I'm going to visit Miami": as duas valem. A primeira é como se fala na rua.

grammar.sentence: If I don't eat now, I'll _____ hungry later.
grammar.explanation: "I'll be hungry" = vou estar com fome. Com "will", o "am/is" vira "be".

grammar.sentence: I will to take a taxi.
grammar.explanation: "Will" vai direto no verbo: "I will take". O "to" só aparece em "going to".
"Gonna" sempre vem com o verbo "to be": "I'm gonna", "you're gonna", "she's gonna".

grammar.passage: Igor: Tomorrow I'm gonna take the ferry to the Statue of Liberty. Then I'll eat a pizza in Brooklyn. Will you come with me?
grammar.question: O que o Igor vai fazer depois da balsa? (responda em inglês)
grammar.explanation: Ele disse "Then I'll eat a pizza in Brooklyn". Repare que ele usou "gonna" e "will" no mesmo plano: os dois funcionam.

listening_speaking.text: Tomorrow I'm gonna take the ferry boat.
I'll take the bus, it's cheaper.
Will you take the train with me tomorrow?
Don't worry, I'll be there at nine.
Next week I'm gonna visit Miami.

roleplay.scenario: O Igorfina vai te mostrar a cidade amanhã e quer saber seus planos. Responda usando o futuro.
roleplay.opening_line: So, big day tomorrow! What are you gonna do?

objectives.hidden_prompt: user states a future plan with gonna/going to/will: 'I'm gonna take the ferry', 'I'll visit the museum', 'I'm going to see the park' — must be in English
examples_pass: I'm going to see Central Park.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user invites him with will/want: 'will you come with me?', 'do you want to come?', 'will you come?' — must be in English

roleplay.closing_cue: Igorfina fecha com "Of course! I'll bring the snacks!" quando obj_2 bater.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 4 turnos):

1. **Student**: ~"I'm gonna take the ferry."
2. **Igorfina**: "Great choice! The view is amazing."
3. **Student**: ~"Will you come with me?"
4. **Igorfina**: "Of course! I'll bring the snacks!"
evaluation_focus: Escolher uma forma de futuro e usar com o verbo básico

guided_chat.scenario: Você e o Igorfina combinam o fim de semana pelo chat.
guided_chat.intro_pt: Combine o fim de semana com o Igorfina. Use I'm gonna ou I'll.
guided_chat.opening_message: Weekend plans? I'm free on Saturday!

objectives.label_pt: Dizer o que vai fazer no sábado
objectives.hidden_prompt: user states a future plan: 'I'm gonna visit the museum', 'I'll go to the beach', 'I'm going to rest' — must be in English
examples_pass: I'm going to sleep a lot.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user asks about his plan: 'what are you gonna do?', 'and you?', 'will you come?' — must be in English
user commits to a time with I'll / I'm gonna: 'I'll be there at ten', 'see you at noon', 'I'm gonna be there at nine' — must be in English
examples_pass: I'm gonna be there at nine.

guided_chat.closing_cue: Igorfina encerra com "Deal! Saturday at ten. Don't be late, ha!" quando obj_3 bater.
guided_chat.suggested_script:
**Script** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Igorfina**: "Weekend plans? I'm free on Saturday!"
2. **Student**: "I'm gonna visit the museum."
3. **Igorfina**: "Nice! I love museums."
4. **Student**: "What are you gonna do?"
5. **Igorfina**: "I'm gonna go with you! What time?"
6. **Student**: "I'll be there at ten."
7. **Igorfina**: "Deal! Saturday at ten. Don't be late, ha!"

units.title: Ontem, hoje e amanhã (juntando tudo)
units.grammar_focus: Revisão: I was / Did you...? / I'm + -ing / I'm gonna, I'll
units.real_life_context: Você conta para um amigo como foi ontem, o que está fazendo hoje e o que vai fazer amanhã.

grammar.explanation: "Yesterday" (ontem) pede passado: "I was". Palavras de tempo ajudam a escolher a forma.

grammar.sentence: Right now I'm _____ for the train.
grammar.explanation: "Right now" (agora mesmo) pede "I'm + -ing": "I'm waiting".
Depois de "gonna", verbo básico: "visit".

grammar.sentence: _____ you see the show last night?
grammar.explanation: "Last night" (ontem à noite) é passado; a pergunta começa com "Did".
"I was so tired" = eu estava muito cansado. Revisão da F11.
"I'm going to Brooklyn" = estou indo para o Brooklyn (hoje, agora).

grammar.sentence: Next week I _____ visit my friend in Boston.
grammar.explanation: "I will visit" (ou "I'll visit") = vou visitar. Revisão da F14.

grammar.sentence: Yesterday I am at the museum.
grammar.answer: Yesterday I was at the museum.
grammar.explanation: Com "yesterday", "am" vira "was". A palavra de tempo e o verbo precisam combinar.

grammar.sentence: Did you went to the park?
grammar.answer: Did you go to the park?
grammar.explanation: "Did" já marca o passado: "Did you go". Revisão da F12.

grammar.passage: Igor: Yesterday I was in Miami. Today I'm flying to New York. Tomorrow I'm gonna see a basketball game!
grammar.question: O que o Igor vai fazer amanhã? (responda em inglês)
grammar.explanation: "Tomorrow I'm gonna see a basketball game": ver um jogo de basquete. Ontem (was), hoje (I'm flying) e amanhã (gonna) numa história só.

listening_speaking.text: Yesterday I was at the beach all day.
Right now I'm waiting for the train.
Tomorrow I'm gonna visit the museum.
Did you see the show last night?
Next week I'll be back in Brazil.

roleplay.scenario: O Igorfina te liga para saber como está a viagem. Conte o ontem, o agora e o amanhã.
roleplay.opening_line: Hey traveler! Tell me everything. How was yesterday?

objectives.hidden_prompt: user talks about yesterday in the past: 'I was at the beach', 'it was great', 'I was so tired' — must be in English

objectives.label_pt: Contar o que está fazendo agora
objectives.hidden_prompt: user says what they are doing now with I'm + -ing: 'I'm eating', 'I'm walking', 'I'm waiting for the train' — must be in English
user states a future plan with gonna/will/going to: 'I'm gonna visit the museum', 'I'll go shopping' — must be in English
objectives.hint_pt: Tomorrow I'm gonna visit the museum.
objectives.hint_en: Tomorrow I'm gonna visit the museum.
examples_pass: Tomorrow I'm gonna visit the museum.
I'm going to see a game.

roleplay.closing_cue: Igorfina fecha com "What a trip! You're speaking like a local, my friend!" quando obj_3 bater.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Student**: ~"I was at the beach."
2. **Igorfina**: "Nice! And right now?"
3. **Student**: ~"I'm waiting for the train."
4. **Igorfina**: "And tomorrow?"
5. **Student**: ~"Tomorrow I'm gonna visit the museum."
6. **Igorfina**: "What a trip! You're speaking like a local, my friend!"
evaluation_focus: Combinar a palavra de tempo com a forma certa (was / I'm -ing / gonna)

guided_chat.scenario: Você manda um resumo da viagem para o grupo da família, e o Igorfina (que está no grupo) faz perguntas.
guided_chat.intro_pt: O Igorfina quer saber da viagem. Responda falando do passado, do presente e do futuro.
guided_chat.opening_message: Family group update! How's the trip going?

objectives.hidden_prompt: user mentions something in the past: 'yesterday I was in Brooklyn', 'I saw a show', 'it was amazing' — must be in English
examples_pass: I saw a show last night.

objectives.label_pt: Perguntar se ele viu as fotos
objectives.label_en: Ask if he saw the photos
objectives.hidden_prompt: user asks with did: 'did you see my photos?', 'did you see the pictures?' — must be in English
user states when they will return with will/gonna: 'I'll be back next week', 'I'm gonna come back on Sunday' — must be in English
examples_pass: I'm gonna come back on Sunday.

guided_chat.closing_cue: Igorfina encerra com "Can't wait! Bring me a souvenir, ha!" quando obj_3 bater.
guided_chat.suggested_script:
**Script** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Igorfina**: "Family group update! How's the trip going?"
2. **Student**: "Yesterday I was in Brooklyn."
3. **Igorfina**: "Brooklyn! Pizza, right?"
4. **Student**: "Did you see my photos?"
5. **Igorfina**: "Yes! Amazing. When are you coming back?"
6. **Student**: "I'll be back next week."
7. **Igorfina**: "Can't wait! Bring me a souvenir, ha!"
